"""Main FastAPI application entry point.

Provides a simple health check endpoint at ``/health`` returning a JSON
payload indicating the service status. This module can be extended with
additional routers, middlewares, and configuration as the project grows.
"""

from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel


class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    """Schema representing the health check response.

    Attributes
    ----------
    status: str
        A textual indicator of service health, typically ``"ok"`` when the
        service is operating normally.
    """

    status: str


app = FastAPI(title="Buddy Agent API", version="1.0.0")


@app.get(
    "/health",
    response_model=HealthResponse,
    tags=["Health"],
    status_code=200,
    summary="Health check endpoint",
    description="Returns a simple JSON object indicating that the service is healthy.",
)
async def health_check() -> HealthResponse:
    """Health check endpoint.

    Returns a mock response with ``status`` set to ``"ok"``. No external
    services or databases are consulted.
    """
    return HealthResponse(status="ok")
